notes: Bag types → Stock settings → Kind “Combo — 1 outer bag + pouches inside”: choose any outer bag, any pouch and 1 to 50 pouches (e.g. S.R.FILLER 7777 5.5 KG X 4 = 1 S.R.FILLER 7777 + 4 × 5 KG POUCH). Each such bag on an invoice takes the outer bag and the pouches out of the stock; the pouch is kept as an inner bag by itself.
